map.note: PostgreSQL; phase 1 products keep the embedded migrator at startup
reads every setting of the product and exits 0, or exits 1 with the Python startup message

commands.rule: Each Python operator command has one som_app subcommand with the same effect and the same settings. Running som_app with no subcommand serves, as in phase 1.

health: GET /healthz answers as the Python product: 200 when the database answers, 503 'database unavailable' otherwise (naming.json W2).

allowed_only_when: scheme http or https; a value without :// is read as http://
local_override.error: <NAME> is allowed only for local test services

rules: A phase 2 Rust product reads the same environment settings as the accepted Python product for the same prompt, with the same defaults, the same refusals and the same messages, so one settings file runs either product.
setting(NAME): a missing or empty value refuses startup with the message '<NAME> is required'.

local_override(NAME): optional; when set it must pass every allowed_only_when condition, or startup is refused with the message in local_override.error. Overrides exist only for local test services; no override reaches a real cloud endpoint.
TEST_MODE is APP_ENV == 'test', read once at startup.
The Rust product never reads TEST_AUTH_HEADERS or TEST_AUTH_COOKIES; they are test-client inputs, as in Python.
A setting outside this file is not read by a phase 2 product. Adding one is an amendment.

DATABASE_URL.accepts: postgresql+psycopg://… as the Python product requires (refused otherwise with 'DATABASE_URL must be a postgresql+psycopg URL'); the Rust driver reads the same URL with the +psycopg driver suffix removed. Phase 1 products keep their frozen postgresql:// form.

JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_FILE.use: RS256 public key of at least 2048 bits

MONGODB_URL.client: server selection timeout 2000 ms, time-zone-aware datetimes; transactions need a replica set or mongos

S3_BUCKET.client: SDK credential chain; connect timeout 2 s, read timeout 5 s, one attempt

SOM_APP_ADDR.use: Rust only, the listen address, as in phase 1; the Python product is addressed by its uvicorn command

SOM_TEST_DATABASE_NAME.use: downgrade runs only with APP_ENV=test and a database named som_test_* equal to this value; it drops the prompt collections and _som_counters

SOM_TEST_OIDC_ISSUER.effect: issuer endpoints <issuer>/authorize, <issuer>/token and <issuer>/jwks instead of the Google endpoints

SOM_TEST_S3_ENDPOINT.effect: path-style addressing and the static credentials local-test/local-test

TEST_DATABASE_URL.use: the product tests; a missing value fails the tests and never skips them
